name: 88345 · Ruidoso, NM
findings: ZIP 88345 (Ruidoso) has 45 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 12 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 88345 (Ruidoso) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 88345 (Ruidoso) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
